hook.text: One in five dental appointments is a no-show — two to four hundred dollars of empty chair each. And a third of new-patient calls go unanswered while the front desk is busy.

save.text: New patient, insurance verified, right provider, right slot — on the schedule before the front desk looked up.

remind.text: The day before, Mia calls to confirm. A cancellation doesn't stay empty — the waitlist gets the slot within minutes.

cta.text: Want a front desk that never misses a call or an empty chair? Let's build it.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Brightside Dental, this is Mia. Are you a new patient or calling about an existing appointment?

call1.speaker: caller
call1.text: New patient. I need a cleaning and a checkup — do you take Delta Dental?

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: We do, and I've verified your plan covers two cleanings a year. I have Thursday at ten with Sam, our hygienist, or Friday at two. Which works?

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Booked. I've texted you the new-patient forms — done in two minutes on your phone. See you Thursday!

call2.speaker: alex
call2.text: Hi Jorge, it's Mia from Brightside Dental confirming your crown appointment tomorrow at two with Dr. Nguyen.

call2.speaker: caller
call2.text: Oh — something came up tomorrow. Can we do Friday instead?

call2.speaker: alex
call2.text: Of course. Friday at ten with Dr. Nguyen is open — I'll move you there and offer tomorrow's slot to our waitlist.
